summary: Radiopharm Theranostics Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC to report an ASX announcement that it dosed the first patient in the second cohort of its Phase 1/2a clinical trial of RV-01 (177Lu-Betabart) for B7-H3 expressing solid tumors, at a 70 mCi dose following a Safety and Monitoring Committee recommendation. This is a routine operational clinical milestone, not a special situation. No deal terms, board actions, or financial transactions were mentioned. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report, incorporated by reference into its Form F-3 registration statement. No special-situation event occurred.
